Since 2001, InfraredSaunaParts have been consistently supplying infrared sauna parts to saunas across the country as well as to other countries. Because we have been in the business for a long time, we have built many strong business relationships because our customers know they can count on us to supply anything and everything that they need.

One of the common items we supply and ship is wood sauna floor. In an infrared sauna, the floors need to be cleaned and maintained regularly to ensure hygiene and safety. Some sauna uses concrete floor with tiles, but this isn’t the best choice because there will be difference of temperature in the sauna room and cold concrete floor can cause thermal shock.

For this reason, many saunas use wood floors and not all sauna wood floors are created equally.

At InfraredSaunaParts, we have many sizes of wood sauna floors. Varying in sizes and designs, you are sure to find one that fits perfectly for your infrared sauna. Our wood sauna floors are made from hemlock and cedar so you’re able to pick the right one for your sauna. What if you can’t find the right one?

Then you could always talk to us about the things you need and we will make sure we find it for you. We’re constantly updating our catalogue so we’re more than happy to make additions to our items.

Let your worry be the thing of the past. We’re able to supply infrared sauna parts even the ones that were manufactured more than 15 years ago. All our goods are safety requirement compliant and certified for usage.
